description: SvForm in Svelte 5 as a schema-driven sign-up form: text, email, password, select, date, switch and rating fields declared in one fields array, required and cross-field custom validation, initial values and a responsive two-column layout, with the submitted values shown as JSON. It is the fastest way to a validated form from the SvGrid UI kit.

faq.question: How do I add validation?
faq.answer: Set required on a field or give it a validate function that receives the value and all values and returns a message; cross-field rules such as confirm password read the other value there.

faq.question: What does onSubmit receive?
faq.answer: An object of field name to value after every rule passes; the demo prints it as JSON. Nothing is called while errors remain.

faq.question: How do I pre-fill the form?
faq.answer: Pass initial with the values to start from; fields not listed start empty or at the type's default.
